mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome! I'm really glad you're here, because together, we're about to step into a refreshingly honest take on self-help—one that doesn't shy away from the messiness of real life. You know, life rarely goes according to plan, and our emotions? They can make things even more complicated. That's where F*ck Feelings by Michael I. Bennett comes in. Instead of offering empty promises about finding perfect happiness or total control, this book invites us to face reality head-on. What if, instead of chasing after constant good vibes, we learned to handle disappointment, frustration, and all those things we just can’t change? Here, you'll find advice that's straightforward—sometimes even blunt—but always practical. It cuts through all the usual self-help noise and speaks directly to the struggles we all face, whether that's in love, at work, or just trying to grow as a person. The real magic? It's about accepting what we can't fix, and letting go of the pressure to be emotionally perfect. When we do that, we open up space to focus on what we can control, and take real steps forward. I’m excited to explore this journey with you—a journey that’s less about endless self-analysis, and more about building real resilience for the challenges life throws our way. So, are you ready? Let's dive in together.
